decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east or west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The single storey side and rear extension is of an appropriate scale, design and location to protect the amenities of adjoining sites in addition to preserving the character of the existing dwelling and the streetscape. The extension is consistent with the Residential Extension Guidelines and also the adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extension and Alterations).
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension to house
